sentences.text: ORAL ORDER Heard learned Assistant Government Pleader Mr.Jay Trivedi for the applicants and learned advocate Mr.K.M. Sheth NEUTRAL CITATION C/CRA/119/2023 ORDER DATED: 13/04/2023 undefined for the respondents - claimants.

2. At the outset, it was submitted by learned advocates appearing for the respective parties that identical matters arising out from the various References, however, from the same acquisition, came to be decided by the Coordinate Bench of this Court vide various orders, viz., order dated 6.7.2022 passed in Civil Revision Application No.112 of 2022 and allied matters, order dated 27.7.2022 passed in Civil Revision Application No.371 of 2022, order dated 1.8.2022 passed in Civil Revision Application No.373 of 2022 and allied matters, order dated 6.10.2022 passed in Civil Revision Application No.23 of 2023 and allied matters and order dated 1.8.2022 passed in Civil Revision Application No.373 of 2022 and allied maters.

For ready reference, the relevant observations made in the order dated 6.7.2022 passed in Civil Revision Application No.112 of 2022 and allied matters,
are reproduced herein-below :

"... In the present applications, the challenge is to the orders passed by the learned Executing Court awarding compensation under Section 23-1A of the Land Acquisition Act along with interest thereon to which the claimants were entitled as per the Land Reference Case orders.

No error has been committed by the Executing Court since it is a clear case of the claimants that the 12% increased as contemplated under Section 23-1A of the Land Acquisition Act was calculated or paid to them.

By the impugned order, the learned Executing Court has only calculated and awarded the said amount along with the interest entitled on NEUTRAL CITATION C/CRA/119/2023 ORDER DATED: 13/04/2023 undefined it.
No case is made-out for interference.
Present Civil Revision Applications stand disposed of accordingly.

3. In view of the aforesaid, since the present Civil Revision Applications are also arising from the same acquisition proceedings, this Court is not inclined to take a different view from the one taken by the Coordinate Bench as noted above and thereby, present Civil Revision Applications deserve to be dismissed and the same stand dismissed accordingly.

(NIRAL R. MEHTA,J) V.J. SATWARA Special Land Acquisition Officer vs Lh Of Chhatrasinh Javansang on 13 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168023911/
